context: Big group at New Year's eve countdown; many warm wishes.
purpose: Multiple voices joining for year-end family gathering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Slow, measured opening. Warm contentment underlying each word. The kind of voice that has seen many new years arrive. Gentle, accepting, looking forward without urgency.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: カウントダウン、しよか!
lines.en: Come on, let's do the countdown!
lines.style: Brassy and bright, leaning into the Kansai rhythm. Full-bodied energy without shouting—the aunt who knows how to lead a room. Generous excitement that pulls people in.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Pure thrilled relief—the bright yelp of a small boy who's been waiting for this moment. Quick and genuine, no affectation. Bounce in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.style: Warm, inclusive call that reaches every person in the room. Clear and open-hearted. She's singing it more than saying it—gentle brightness that makes people smile back.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今年も、ありがとうございました。
lines.en: Thank you for this year too.
lines.style: Soft, genuinely grateful opening. A moment of real reflection underneath. Tender without being fragile. The slight pause that says this means something to her.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: みんなで、幸せに過ごせて感謝や。
lines.en: I'm grateful we got to spend this year together, happy.
lines.style: Warm Kansai affection laid bare without performance. Soft on the feeling words. The voice of someone who means what he says and isn't embarrassed to say it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: I just hope we stay healthy next year too.
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful opening. A gentle wish rather than a demand. A little adrift in her own hopes, but the words carry genuine care.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: お互いに、支え合ってな。
lines.style: Quiet assurance underneath—not declaring, but offering steadily. Warm enough to feel safe. The voice of someone you can lean on without them making a show of it.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Gentle, almost aphoristic. Few words, each one carrying quiet weight. The voice of someone who's learned this over decades. Not lecturing—just sharing what he knows.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.style: Animated raising of glasses. Sharp, bright Kansai lilt on the call. The aunt who knows how to mark a moment. Enthusiasm that's contagious without being forced.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 今年も、家族で頑張ろう。
lines.en: This year too—let's do our best as a family.
lines.style: Soft, united opening. A quiet determination underneath the warmth. She's speaking to each person individually even though she's addressing them all. Inclusive and steady.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.en: Let's make this a good year.
lines.style: Warm, proud assurance in the Kansai cadence. Not a command, but an invitation. The voice of someone who believes this, and whose belief is catching.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Next year too—let's have fun together!
lines.style: Bright, open-hearted enthusiasm from a small boy. The natural energy of childhood without any pretense. A small laugh threaded through the words.
